text: ●Student Affirmations signed by the applicant (template can be downloaded on BFSU system)●Copy of diploma/pre-graduation certificateIf the original is not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation should be attached.●Copy of transcript of academic recordIf the original is not in Chinese or English, a notarized Chinese or English translation should be attached.●Photocopy of the HSK certificateApplicants with HSK Level 4 (180 or above) are preferred.●Copy of the first page of valid ordinary passport●Visa page (only for applicants who are studying at local schools in China currently)●Application Form for Chinese Government ScholarshipThe form can be downloaded after the applicant submits the application information online via the Chinese Government Scholarship Information System.●Physical Examination Record for Foreigner (template can be downloaded on BFSU system; Must be completed in English. The validity period of the examination results is 6 months.)●Non-criminal Record Report (template can be downloaded on BFSU system; Certification documents issued within 6 months prior to the application date.)●Other supporting materials, including letters of recommendation or certificates of awards (not compulsory)
